title: Homeowner Autopay Increment to the Direct Card Limit
content:
**Rule.** The homeowner autopay increment raises the direct card limit on a Real Estate Service Contracts buyer-only order for a buyer whose Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts premiums are drawn by automatic bank draft, according to the bank-draft premium payments on the buyer's homeowner contracts in the twelve months before the payment date.

| Bank-draft premium payments on the buyer's homeowner contracts in the twelve months before the payment date | Homeowner autopay increment |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | $100.00 |
| at least 1 but fewer than 10 | $50.00 |
| none | nothing |

It is added once to the direct card limit, before the card payments already taken on the order are deducted from the limit and the limit is floored at zero.

## Records read

From the Homeowner Service Contracts records: the premium payments on the buyer's homeowner contracts, their payment method (bank draft or otherwise) and their dates. Premium payments made by card or other methods do not count.

## Illustrations (hypothetical buyers)

| Premium payments in the window | Increment |
|---|---|
| 12 by bank draft | $100.00 |
| 9 by bank draft and 3 by card | $50.00 |
| 12 by card | nothing |
